beats.html:
It opened in July 1993,
against summer
blockbusters, and
lost money.

It only became a classic
because it ran on TV
every October until a
generation assumed
it always had.

It didn't get better.
It got found.

She's 19, and she only
just became the
main character.

19 years old, 10 of them mine.
15 pages of what actually
keeps her comfortable.
Free, and yours.

beats.html:
She is never going
to explain herself.

Sarah Winchester built
a house for 35 years
and never once
said why.

Bought it in 1886, kept
building until she
died in 1922.

Every ghost story about
that house was written
after she was dead, by
people who couldn't
stand not knowing.

People will build you a
whole haunted house
rather than accept
the silence.

19 years old, 10 of them mine.
15 pages of what actually
keeps her comfortable.
Free, and yours.

beats.html:
Robert L. May wrote him
in 1939 as a free
giveaway booklet for
Montgomery Ward.

He was in debt. His wife
was dying. That was
the year he wrote it.

The most cheerful
character of the season
came out of the worst
year of a man's life.

About being the one
who doesn't fit.

19 years old, 10 of them mine.
15 pages of what actually
keeps her comfortable.
Free, and yours.

clip.match_reason: The turn is that the most cheerful thing of the season came out of the worst year of a life. So the plate has to actually be cheerful. This one is: Amanda genuinely smiling down at Cesa in a hat, indoors, warm light. The porch frame it replaces shows endurance, not warmth, which contradicted the line it was carrying.
